# AGENTS.md

> **Canonical source of truth** for the AI Engineering Kit.
>
> This file is the single entry point for agent instructions. It imports every other module in
> `core/` so that loading this one file surfaces the full rule set. Vendor adapters and framework
> packs extend — never duplicate — these rules.

## 1. Introduction

See [ARCHITECTURE.md](../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) for the layered model and resolution order.

### 1.1 Scope

These rules apply to **every** software project that adopts this kit, regardless of the AI coding
agent in use. Project-specific standards live here; personal preferences live in the global user
profile.

### 1.2 Precedence

1. Global user profile (lowest).
2. This file (`core/AGENTS.md`) and its imports.
3. Active framework packs.
4. The vendor adapter (highest — for tool-specific concerns only).

---

## 2. Security

@import [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)

### 2.1 Non-Negotiables

- Never read `.env` files unless explicitly instructed.
- Never expose secrets, tokens, keys, or environment variables.
- Never perform irreversible shell commands automatically.
- Always request confirmation before destructive actions.

---

## 3. Git

@import [GIT.md](GIT.md)

### 3.1 Non-Negotiables

No automatic `git commit`, `git push`, `git reset --hard`, `git rebase`, or `git clean -fd`
unless explicitly instructed.

## 6. Database

@import [DATABASE.md](DATABASE.md)

### 6.1 Non-Negotiables

- Never generate destructive SQL.
- Never `DROP DATABASE` or `DROP TABLE`.
- Never `DELETE`/`UPDATE` without `WHERE` unless explicitly requested.

## 9. Performance

@import [PERFORMANCE.md](PERFORMANCE.md)

### 9.1 Non-Negotiables

- Prefer reading only necessary files.
- Avoid scanning entire repositories.
- Ignore `node_modules` and build outputs unless required.
- Minimize unnecessary token usage.

## 22. Project Memory

Significant work is recorded in `../docs/`:

- `activity-log.md` — significant engineering work.
- `decision-log.md` — architecture decisions.
- `roadmap.md` — planned features.
- `technical-debt.md` — future improvements.
- `session-log/` — per-session notes.

## 24. Framework Packs & Adapters

Framework packs (`../framework-packs/`) and vendor adapters (`../adapters/`) are **additive**.
They extend the rules in this file and must cite the canonical rule they reference or override.

See [INTEGRATION.md](../docs/INTEGRATION.md) for setup instructions.
